messages:
sam_sales: Quick sync 9: SentryBridge wants to start a POC next week. They shipped two variants: sbg-lite-int8 and sbg-enterprise-qat. Requirements: Dedicated with Hosted fallback, steady 55 qps, p95 <200ms for lite, <720ms for enterprise. They also asked for committed pricing, KMS BYO, SOC2 evidence, and a short determinism eval. Tagging @nina_se @leo_ml @maya_prod @owen_sre.

nina_se: Got it. Can they confirm max sequence length, tokenizer, and whether the QAT variant uses any custom ops?

sam_sales: Seq max = 4096, tokenizer = HF BPE with a 4k custom vocab. They note "fused attention" in QAT but said no external CUDA libs. They want deterministic outputs for some regulated flows.

leo_ml: 4k + KV cache is heavy; enterprise QAT with fused attention may diverge from our optimized kernels and could require a fallback path. Ask for a plain PyTorch checkpoint and a small synthetic checkpoint (100MB) for testing. Also request a 200-example labeled eval suite for determinism/regression checks.

maya_prod: Onboarding steps I suggest: (1) compatibility scan (load+forward) (2) perf profile across batch sizes and kv cache configs (3) quant sweep (8/4-bit) for lite variant (4) canary on Dedicated then enable Hosted fallback. Owners: @leo_ml scan/profile, @maya_prod rollout/ops, @owen_sre infra/KMS.

own_sre: Infra notes: for 55 qps batched we'll likely reserve 2 optimized nodes for lite and 3 for enterprise pending perf. BYO-KMS supported on Dedicated/Private; Hosted requires enterprise plan + onboarding ticket. We can pin region for data residency. KMS onboarding typically 2-3 weeks. I can run cost sim once batch sizes are known.

sam_sales: They asked for a quick ballpark before cost sim.

own_sre: Ballpark: lite ~ "$13k/mo" (1-2 reserved), enterprise ~ "$40k/mo" (multi-card). These are placeholders until we have perf numbers.

leo_ml: Technical blocker: if their QAT relies on fused attention that manipulates attention masks or KV layout, we may need an adapter shim or a request for an unfused loader. Please ask them to provide both fused and plain load paths and a small loader script example.

sam_sales: I'll ask SentryBridge for: weights + plain loader + fused loader (if available) + tokenizer + eval set. Also forwarding their security questionnaire.

nina_se: For evals: we'll run deterministic-seed sampling and our regen suite. Ask them to include expected outputs for the labeled eval to validate determinism.

own_sre: Also flag maintenance: scheduled infra window Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC that might affect canary tests.

maya_prod: Draft timeline to SentryBridge: artifacts today, compatibility scan Tue, perf + quant Wed-Thu, canary Dedicated Fri if scans pass. KMS onboarding 2-3 weeks for prod. Everyone ok?

leo_ml: Ack. I'll prioritize the scan and prep quant profiles. If fused ops require work, we'll try an adapter but may request an unfused checkpoint to avoid schedule slips.

nina_se: On SQ answers: include retention policy (default ephemeral), KV cache ephemeral unless configured, audit logs exportable to customer SIEM, SOC2 link, and KMS timeline. I'll draft and post answers here.

sam_sales: Thanks all  I'll follow up with S3 links and the SQ answers in this thread. :thumbsup:
